name: Caelestia Animated Timer
description: Native dashboard timer with a slim monitor notch and animated sand hourglass.
permissions: Run one standard-library Python timer helper independently of Dev Manager.
Persist durations, custom presets, preferences, active countdown and pending alarm in XDG_STATE_HOME/animated-timer.

Repeat an original completion bell until stopped; show an actionable persistent desktop notification, and close only the timer notification on Stop. Run notify-send, canberra-gtk-play and gdbus for these controls.
Display a non-focusable per-monitor Wayland timer notch and open the host dashboard Timer tab on click.

Dev Manager's dedicated Timer adapter reviews two checksum-pinned dashboard host files, enables this plugin and reloads the shell after a reviewed lifecycle action. Requires Timer-capable Dev Manager 0.6.0.
